What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/passhash.rst warns that bcrypt is built on Blowfish, which uses key-dependent tables indexed by secret data, and is thus likely vulnerable to cache-based side channels; no constant-time implementation is available.

`bcrypt` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends, as its only template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
